name: The Hollow Table — In-Person Narration Pack

clips.text: [clear, warm, measured, confident] The voice of the house is ready. Keep this phone nearby, and set the volume so every word can be heard.
[low, calm, mysterious, deliberate] Your identity has been chosen. Read your card in silence. Keep it secret. Confirm when you are ready.
[deep, quiet, authoritative] Everyone, close your eyes. The house is watching.
[cold, commanding, ominous, clear projection] Mafia, awaken. Choose one living soul. You must agree on the same target before the night can continue.
[tense, controlled, urgent] The Mafia are divided. This is your final chance to agree. If you remain divided, no one will be taken tonight.
[low, firm, final] Mafia, close your eyes. Your choice is sealed.
[soft, warm, gentle, reassuring] Angel, awaken. One life may be in danger. Choose one soul to protect. Your choice is final tonight.
[soft, calm, mysterious] Angel, close your eyes. Let the house fall quiet.
[serious, investigative, measured] Sheriff, awaken. Choose one person to investigate. Your answer will appear privately on your phone.
[deep, quiet, conclusive] Sheriff, close your eyes. The last secret is sealed.
[rising, resonant, dramatic] Town, open your eyes. Dawn has reached the house.
[measured, authoritative, suspenseful] The day is yours. Speak carefully, listen closely, and decide whom you trust. The clock is running.
[firm, ceremonial, commanding] It is time to vote. Choose the person you believe is hiding the truth. Your vote is private.
[grave, tense, deliberate] The table has not agreed. The accused will face one final vote. Choose carefully.
[stern, authoritative] The final vote begins now. Only the names shown on your screen may be chosen.
[low, grave, slow, cinematic] Morning has come. One soul did not return from the night. Look to the screen. The house will reveal who is missing.
[mysterious, restrained, resonant] Morning has come, yet no one is missing. Something moved through the darkness and left no trace.
[solemn, authoritative, deliberate] The table has delivered its judgement. One seat is now empty. Remember the choice you have made.
[grave, measured, final] The votes remain divided. The house accepts no verdict. No one leaves the table.
[somber, quiet, deliberate] A seat has fallen silent. The house counts the absence, and the game continues.
[powerful, chilling, cinematic] The last candle dies. The Mafia have claimed the house. The table belongs to the darkness.
[warm, triumphant, resonant] The final shadow has fallen. The town has uncovered every hidden hand. Tonight, the house is silent.
